jobs.description:
Einführung

Du arbeitest gerne mit den Händen, hast Fingerspitzengefühl und legst Wert auf exakte Arbeit? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

In dieser Rolle montierst du hochwertige Belimo Feldgeräte an der Produktionslinie. Mit deiner präzisen Arbeitsweise trägst du dazu bei, dass unsere Produkte weltweit höchsten Qualitätsansprüchen entsprechen.

Wir suchen Mitarbeitende für unsere Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht. Die Anstellung erfolgt jeweils fest für eine Schicht. Bewirb dich gerne auf die Schicht, die am besten zu deinem Alltag passt.

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten

• Montage von Fertigprodukten und Baugruppen gemäss Fertigungsauftrag

• Prüfung der montierten Produkte nach vorgegebenen Qualitätsstandards

• Sorgfältiges Arbeiten mit Einzelteilen und Komponenten

• Transportgerechtes Verpacken der fertigen Produkte

• Einhalten von Montage-, Qualitäts- und Prozessvorgaben

Erforderliche Fachkenntnisse

• Gute Feinmotorik und Freude an präziser Handarbeit

• Sorgfältige, zuverlässige und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise

• Körperliche Fitness und Bereitschaft, während der Arbeit überwiegend zu stehen

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse zum Verstehen von Arbeitsanweisungen

• Erfahrung in der Produktion oder Montage von Vorteil

• Auch motivierte Quereinsteigerinnen und Quereinsteiger sind willkommen

Menschen bei Belimo

Intelligente Gebäude entstehen durch engagierte Menschen. Wir bringen talentierte Menschen zusammen und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem sie erfolgreich sein können. Bei Belimo tragen Respekt, Vertrauen und gegenseitige Unterstützung über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg dazu bei, dass aus Ideen rasch praktische Lösungen werden. Denn gemeinsam erreichen wir mehr, als wir alleine je erreichen könnten.

Über Belimo

Belimo ist Weltmarktführer in Entwicklung, Herstellung und Vertrieb von Feldgeräten zur energieeffizienten Regelung von Heizungs-, Lüftungs- und Klimaanlagen. Klappenantriebe, Regelventile, Sensoren und Zähler bilden dabei unser Kerngeschäft. Das 1975 gegründete Unternehmen ist seit 1995 an der Schweizer Börse (SIX) kotiert.

Vergütung und Zusatzleistungen

Wir bei Belimo glauben an eine faire, gerechte und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung. Wir bieten ein Gehalt, das deinen Fähigkeiten, deiner Erfahrung, deiner Ausbildung und deinem Einsatzort entspricht. Neben der Vergütung profitierst du von umfassenden Zusatzleistungen, die dein mentales, körperliches, finanzielles und soziales Wohlbefinden unterstützen. Belimo ist stolz darauf, eine Arbeitgeberin zu sein, die Chancengleichheit fördert.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione

Ti piace lavorare con le mani, avere le dita e attribuire importanza al lavoro esatto? Allora hai ragione con noi.

In questo ruolo, si montano dispositivi di campo Belimo di alta qualità sulla linea di produzione. Con il vostro modo preciso di lavorare, aiutate a garantire che i nostri prodotti soddisfano i più elevati standard di qualità in tutto il mondo.

Siamo alla ricerca di dipendenti per il nostro turno di prima, tardi o di notte. L'impostazione è in ogni caso fissato per uno strato. Applicati allo strato che meglio si adatta alla tua vita quotidiana.

Principali responsabilità

• Montaggio di prodotti finiti e assemblaggi secondo ordine di produzione

• Test di prodotti assemblati secondo standard di qualità specificati

• Lavoro attento con parti e componenti individuali

• Imballaggio trasportabile dei prodotti finiti

• conformità con le specifiche di montaggio, qualità e processo

Competenza necessaria

• Buone abilità motorie e godimento di preciso lavoro manuale

• Metodo di lavoro attento, affidabile e di qualità

• Fitness fisica e disponibilità a stare prevalentemente durante il lavoro

• Buona conoscenza del tedesco per comprendere le istruzioni di lavoro

• L'esperienza nella produzione o nel montaggio è vantaggiosa

• Anche i vignanti laterali motivati sono benvenuti

Persone a Belimo

Gli edifici intelligenti sono creati da persone impegnate. Portiamo insieme persone di talento e creiamo un ambiente in cui possono avere successo. A Belimo, il rispetto, la fiducia e il sostegno reciproco attraverso i confini dipartimentali aiutano a trasformare rapidamente le idee in soluzioni pratiche. Insieme riusciamo a raggiungere più di quanto potremmo mai raggiungere da soli.

Informazioni su Belimo

Belimo è leader mondiale nello sviluppo, nella produzione e nella vendita di dispositivi di campo per il controllo efficiente dell'impianto di riscaldamento, ventilazione e condizionamento dell'aria. Azionatrici, valvole di controllo, sensori e metri formano il nostro core business. Fondata nel 1975, la società è quotata in Borsa svizzera (SIX) dal 1995.

Remunerazione e benefici aggiuntivi

A Belimo, crediamo in una compensazione equa, giusta e competitiva. Offriamo uno stipendio che corrisponde alle tue competenze, esperienza, istruzione e posizione. Oltre alla compensazione, si beneficia di servizi aggiuntivi completi che supportano il vostro benessere mentale, fisico, finanziario e sociale. Belimo è orgogliosa di essere un datore di lavoro che promuove pari opportunità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction

Do you like to work with your hands, have your fingertips and attach importance to exact work? Then you are exactly right with us.

In this role, you mount high-quality Belimo field devices on the production line. With your precise way of working, you help ensure that our products meet the highest quality standards worldwide.

We are looking for employees for our early, late or night shift. The setting is in each case fixed for one layer. Apply yourself to the layer that best suits your everyday life.

Main responsibilities

• Assembly of finished products and assemblies according to production order

• Testing of assembled products according to specified quality standards

• Careful work with individual parts and components

• Transportable packaging of the finished products

• Compliance with assembly, quality and process specifications

Required expertise

• Good fine motor skills and enjoyment of precise manual work

• Careful, reliable and quality-conscious work method

• Physical fitness and willingness to stand predominantly during work

• Good knowledge of German to understand work instructions

• Experience in production or assembly is advantageous

• Motivated lateral entrants are also welcome

People at Belimo

Intelligent buildings are created by committed people. We bring talented people together and create an environment where they can succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust and mutual support across departmental boundaries help turn ideas quickly into practical solutions. Together we achieve more than we could ever achieve alone.

About Belimo

Belimo is the world market leader in the development, manufacture and sale of field devices for energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems. Flap drives, control valves, sensors and meters form our core business. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Stock Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Remuneration and additional benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, fair and competitive compensation. We offer a salary that matches your skills, experience, education and location. In addition to the compensation, you benefit from comprehensive additional services that support your mental, physical, financial and social well-being. Belimo is proud to be an employer promoting equal opportunities.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Présentation

Vous aimez travailler avec vos mains, avoir le bout des doigts et attacher de l'importance au travail exact? Alors tu as raison avec nous.

Dans ce rôle, vous montez des dispositifs de terrain Belimo de haute qualité sur la ligne de production. Grâce à votre façon de travailler précise, vous vous assurez que nos produits répondent aux normes de qualité les plus élevées du monde.

Nous cherchons des employés pour notre service tôt, tard ou de nuit. Le réglage est dans chaque cas fixé pour un calque. Appliquez-vous à la couche qui convient le mieux à votre vie quotidienne.

Principales responsabilités

• Montage des produits finis et assemblages selon ordre de production

• Essai des produits assemblés selon des normes de qualité spécifiées

• Travail soigné avec pièces et composants individuels

• Emballage transportable des produits finis

• Conformité avec les spécifications de montage, de qualité et de procédé

Compétences requises

• Bonnes compétences motrices et jouissance d'un travail manuel précis

• Méthode de travail prudente, fiable et soucieuse de la qualité

• Aptitude physique et volonté de se tenir principalement pendant le travail

• Bonne connaissance de l'allemand pour comprendre les instructions de travail

• L'expérience en production ou en montage est avantageuse

• Les participants latéraux motivés sont également les bienvenus

Les gens de Belimo

Les bâtiments intelligents sont créés par des personnes engagées. Nous réunissons des gens talentueux et créons un environnement où ils peuvent réussir. Chez Belimo, le respect, la confiance et le soutien mutuel au-delà des frontières ministérielles aident à transformer rapidement les idées en solutions pratiques. Ensemble, nous obtenons plus que nous n'aurions jamais pu atteindre seuls.

À propos de Belimo

Belimo est le leader mondial dans le développement, la fabrication et la vente de dispositifs de terrain pour le contrôle énergétique des systèmes de chauffage, de ventilation et de climatisation. Les moteurs à flamme, les vannes de commande, les capteurs et les compteurs forment notre activité principale. Fondée en 1975, la société est cotée à la Bourse suisse (SIX) depuis 1995.

Rémunération et prestations supplémentaires

Chez Belimo, nous croyons en une rémunération juste, équitable et concurrentielle. Nous offrons un salaire qui correspond à vos compétences, expérience, éducation et emplacement. En plus de la rémunération, vous bénéficiez de services supplémentaires complets qui soutiennent votre bien-être mental, physique, financier et social. Belimo est fier d'être un employeur qui favorise l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Agile Project Manager (80-100%)
jobs.description:
Introduction

Lead the delivery of complex software development and digital product initiatives in a highly collaborative Agile environment. You will align business goals with engineering execution, ensure predictable and value-driven delivery, and drive continuous improvement across teams, processes, and release practices.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end delivery of complex software and digital product projects, balancing scope, timeline, quality, and business value.

• Coordinate dependencies across development teams, Product Owners, architects, quality, cybersecurity, IT, and business stakeholders.

• Drive roadmap execution, release planning, and delivery forecasting aligned with strategic priorities.

• Establish transparency through Agile planning, dashboards, delivery metrics, and reporting.

• Identify and mitigate risks, dependencies, and delivery obstacles to ensure successful outcomes.

• Facilitate stakeholder alignment, communication, and decision-making across all organizational levels.

• Support Agile ways of working and foster continuous improvement through retrospectives and delivery reviews.

• Coordinate product releases, go-live activities, and post-release follow-up to ensure smooth deployments.

Required Expertise

• Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Several years of experience leading software development, digital product, or technology projects in Agile environments.

• Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, Lean, or SAFe.

• Proven experience coordinating cross-functional software teams and managing stakeholder expectations.

• Solid understanding of software development lifecycle, release management, backlog management, and Agile delivery practices.

• Hands-on experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Planview, or similar platforms.

• Excellent communication, facilitation, and analytical skills with the ability to influence decision-making.

• Strong English skills; advanced German is highly desirable. Agile certifications are a plus.

People at Belimo

Smart buildings start with dedicated people. We bring talented people together and foster an environment to succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust, and support across departments help ideas move quickly into real-world solutions, because we achieve more together than we ever could alone.

About Belimo

Belimo is the global market leader in the development, production, and sales of field devices for the energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air-conditioning systems. The focus of our core business is on damper actuators, control valves, sensors and meters. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Compensation & Benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, equitable, and competitive compensation. We offer pay that reflects your skills, experience, education, and location. Beyond compensation, you'll benefit from a comprehensive rewards package designed to support your health, financial wellbeing, and long-term success. Belimo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione

Condurre la consegna di complesse iniziative di sviluppo software e prodotti digitali in un ambiente Agile altamente collaborativo. Potrai allineare gli obiettivi aziendali con l'esecuzione di ingegneria, garantire la consegna prevedibile e orientata al valore, e guidare il miglioramento continuo tra team, processi e pratiche di rilascio.

Principali responsabilità

• Consegna end-to-end di progetti di software complessi e prodotti digitali, bilanciamento della portata, timeline, qualità e valore aziendale.

• Coordinare le dipendenze tra team di sviluppo, Proprietari di prodotti, architetti, qualità, sicurezza informatica, e stakeholder aziendali.

• Guidare l'esecuzione roadmap, la pianificazione del rilascio e la previsione di consegna allineati con priorità strategiche.

• Stabilire la trasparenza attraverso la pianificazione Agile, dashboard, metriche di consegna e reporting.

• Identificare e mitigare i rischi, le dipendenze e gli ostacoli di consegna per garantire risultati di successo.

• Facilitare l'allineamento delle parti interessate, la comunicazione e il processo decisionale in tutti i livelli organizzativi.

• Supporto Agile modi di lavorare e favorire il miglioramento continuo attraverso retrospettive e recensioni di consegna.

• Coordinate le release dei prodotti, le attività di go-live e il follow-up post-release per garantire implementazioni fluide.

Competenza richiesta

• Laurea in Informatica, ingegneria del software, ingegneria elettrica, o una disciplina tecnica correlata.

• Diversi anni di esperienza leader sviluppo software, prodotti digitali o progetti tecnologici in ambienti Agile.

• Forte conoscenza delle metodologie Agile come Scrum, Kanban, Lean o SAFe.

• Esperienza comprovata che coordina i team software interfunzionali e la gestione delle aspettative degli stakeholder.

• Solida comprensione del ciclo di vita dello sviluppo del software, gestione del rilascio, gestione del backlog e pratiche di consegna Agile.

• Esperienza pratica con strumenti come Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Planview o piattaforme simili.

• Ottima comunicazione, facilitazione e competenze analitiche con la capacità di influenzare il processo decisionale.

• Forte abilità inglese; tedesco avanzato è altamente desiderabile. Le certificazioni Agile sono un plus.

Persone a Belimo

Gli edifici intelligenti iniziano con persone dedicate. Portiamo insieme persone di talento e adottiamo un ambiente per avere successo. A Belimo, il rispetto, la fiducia e il supporto nei dipartimenti aiutano le idee a muoversi rapidamente in soluzioni del mondo reale, perché raggiungiamo più insieme di quanto mai potremmo soli.

Informazioni su Belimo

Belimo è leader del mercato globale nello sviluppo, produzione e vendita di dispositivi di campo per il controllo efficiente dell'energia dei sistemi di riscaldamento, ventilazione e climatizzazione. Il focus del nostro core business è sugli attuatori ammortizzatori, valvole di controllo, sensori e metri. Fondata nel 1975, la società è quotata sulla Borsa Svizzera (SIX) dal 1995.

Compensazioni e vantaggi

A Belimo, crediamo in una compensazione equa, equa e competitiva. Offriamo la paga che riflette le vostre abilità, esperienza, istruzione e la posizione. Oltre alla compensazione, potrete beneficiare di un pacchetto completo di ricompense progettato per sostenere la vostra salute, benessere finanziario e successo a lungo termine. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Présentation

Diriger la prestation de projets complexes de développement de logiciels et de produits numériques dans un environnement agile hautement collaboratif. Vous alignerez les objectifs opérationnels sur l'exécution de l'ingénierie, assurerez une prestation prévisible et axée sur la valeur et favoriserez l'amélioration continue des équipes, des processus et des pratiques de diffusion.

Principales responsabilités

• Diriger la livraison de bout en bout de projets complexes de logiciels et de produits numériques, d'équilibrer la portée, le calendrier, la qualité et la valeur opérationnelle.

• Coordonner les dépendances entre les équipes de développement, les propriétaires de produits, les architectes, la qualité, la cybersécurité, les TI et les intervenants commerciaux.

• Diriger l'exécution de la feuille de route, la planification de la diffusion et les prévisions de livraison en fonction des priorités stratégiques.

• Établir la transparence par l'entremise de la planification agile, des tableaux de bord, des indicateurs de prestation et des rapports.

• Déterminer et atténuer les risques, les dépendances et les obstacles à la prestation des services afin d'assurer la réussite.

• Faciliter l'harmonisation des intervenants, la communication et la prise de décisions à tous les niveaux organisationnels.

• Soutenir les méthodes de travail agiles et favoriser l'amélioration continue par des rétrospectives et des examens de la prestation.

• Coordonner les rejets de produits, les activités de lancement et le suivi après la libération afin d'assurer un déploiement sans heurts.

Expertise requise

• Expérience éprouvée en matière de coordination des équipes de logiciels interfonctionnels et de gestion des attentes des intervenants.

Les gens de Belimo

Les bâtiments intelligents commencent par des personnes dédiées. Nous réunissons des gens talentueux et nous favorisons un environnement propice à la réussite. Chez Belimo, le respect, la confiance et le soutien à travers les ministères aident les idées à passer rapidement à des solutions concrètes, parce que nous obtenons plus ensemble que nous ne le pouvions jamais.

À propos de Belimo

Belimo est le leader mondial dans le développement, la production et la vente de dispositifs de terrain pour le contrôle énergétique des systèmes de chauffage, de ventilation et de climatisation. Nos activités principales sont les actionneurs d'amortisseurs, les vannes de commande, les capteurs et les compteurs. Fondée en 1975, la société est cotée à la Bourse suisse (SIX) depuis 1995.

Rémunération et avantages sociaux

Chez Belimo, nous croyons en une rémunération juste, équitable et concurrentielle. Nous offrons une rémunération qui reflète vos compétences, votre expérience, vos études et votre emplacement. Au-delà de la rémunération, vous bénéficierez d'un ensemble complet de récompenses conçu pour soutenir votre santé, votre bien-être financier et votre succès à long terme. Belimo est fier d'être un employeur pour l'égalité des chances.

Wer du bist

Du willst komplexe Produktionsanlagen nicht nur zum Laufen bringen, sondern kontinuierlich besser machen ? Bei uns verbindest Du technisches Expertenwissen mit modernen digitalen Technologien und KI und gestaltest die Zukunft unseres Manufacturing Engineering aktiv mit.

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten

• Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für die Inbetriebnahme, Verifizierung und Qualifizierung komplexer Produktionsanlagen und begleitest diese bis zur erfolgreichen Übergabe an die Produktion.

• Du steuerst anspruchsvolle FAT-, SAT-, IQ-, OQ- und PQ-Aktivitäten und arbeitest dabei eng mit Engineering, Produktion, Qualität, Lieferanten und unseren internationalen Standorten zusammen.

• Du begleitest Software-Deployments, Anlagen-Upgrades und Transfers und stellst sicher, dass Anlagen und Software im jeweiligen Produktionsumfeld zuverlässig funktionieren.

• Bei komplexen technischen Herausforderungen bist Du die zentrale Ansprechperson: Du führst Root-Cause-Analysen durch und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Teams nachhaltige Lösungen.

• Du unterstützt unsere Produktionsstandorte bei Ramp-ups, technischen Eskalationen sowie Modernisierungen und Lifecycle-Themen.

• Deine Erfahrungen aus Projekten und Inbetriebnahmen nutzt Du, um Deployment-Methoden, Standards, Checklisten und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und standortübergreifend zu harmonisieren.

• Du nutzt digitale Technologien und KI-Tools, um Störungsbehebung, Engineering, Dokumentation und Wissensmanagement kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

• Als technische:r Expert:in förderst Du den Wissensaustausch innerhalb des Manufacturing Engineering und bringst Deine Expertise in Reviews, Lessons Learned und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Methoden ein.

Erforderliche Fachkenntnisse

• Du verfügst über ein technisches Studium (FH/Uni), z. B. in Automation, Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Mechatronik oder Produktionstechnik. Dies kombiniert mit umfassender relevanter Praxiserfahrung.

• Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit Produktionsanlagen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Inbetriebnahme, Verifizierung, Qualifizierung, Ramp-up und technischem Lifecycle Support.

• Du bist ein echter Hands-on Engineer: Du arbeitest gerne direkt an Anlagen und Systemen, gehst technischen Problemen auf den Grund und setzt Lösungen auch selbst in die Praxis um.

• Du besitzt hohe Affinität zu KI-Themen – idealerweise auch vertiefte Erfahrungen damit.

• Du kennst Dich mit Automatisierung, Anlagensoftware, Schnittstellen und Qualifizierungsprozessen wie FAT/SAT sowie IQ/OQ/PQ sehr gut aus.

• Komplexe technische Probleme gehst Du analytisch und strukturiert an und überzeugst durch Eigeninitiative, Umsetzungsstärke und Verantwortungsbewusstsein.

• Du arbeitest gerne interdisziplinär, gibst Dein Wissen weiter und kannst andere mit Deiner fachlichen Kompetenz überzeugen und unterstützen, auch ohne disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung.

• Du kommunizierst sehr gut auf Englisch und bist bereit, bei wichtigen Projektphasen oder technischen Herausforderungen punktuell national und international zu reisen.

Menschen bei Belimo

Intelligente Gebäude entstehen durch engagierte Menschen. Wir bringen talentierte Menschen zusammen und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem sie erfolgreich sein können. Bei Belimo tragen Respekt, Vertrauen und gegenseitige Unterstützung über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg dazu bei, dass aus Ideen rasch praktische Lösungen werden. Denn gemeinsam erreichen wir mehr, als wir allene je erreichen könnten.

Ueber Belimo

Belimo ist Weltmarktführer in Entwicklung, Herstellung und Vertrieb von Feldgeräten zur energieeffizienten Regelung von Heizungs-, Lüftungs- und Klimaanlagen. Klappenantriebe, Regelventile, Sensoren und Zähler bilden dabei unser Kerngeschäft. Das 1975 gegründete Unternehmen ist seit 1995 an der Schweizer Börse (SIX) kotiert.

Compensation & Benefits

Bei Belimo glauben wir an eine faire, gerechte und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung. Wir bieten ein Gehalt, dass Deinen Fähigkeiten, Deiner Erfahrung, Deiner Ausbildung und Deinem Einsatz entspricht. Nebst Vergütung profitierst Du von umfassenden Zusatzleistungen, welche Dein mentales, körperliches, finanzielles und soziales Wohlbefinden unterstützen. Belimo ist stolz darauf, eine Arbeitgeberin zu sein, die Chancengleichheit fördert.

Non si vuole solo fare il lavoro di impianti di produzione complessi, ma anche migliorare continuamente? Con noi, si combinano competenze tecniche con le moderne tecnologie digitali e AI e modellano attivamente il futuro della nostra ingegneria manifatturiera.

Principali responsabilità

• Si assume la responsabilità tecnica per la messa in servizio, la verifica e la qualificazione di complessi impianti di produzione e li accompagna fino al trasferimento di successo alla produzione.

• Si controlla impegnative attività FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ e PQ, lavorando a stretto contatto con l'ingegneria, la produzione, la qualità, i fornitori e le nostre sedi internazionali.

• Accompagnate le implementazioni software, gli aggiornamenti e i trasferimenti di impianti e assicurate che impianti e software funzionino in modo affidabile nel rispettivo ambiente di produzione.

• Nelle complesse sfide tecniche, siete la persona di contatto centrale: fate analisi delle cause e sviluppate soluzioni sostenibili insieme ai team coinvolti.

• Sostenete i nostri siti di produzione con ramp-up, escalations tecniche e modernizzazione e temi del ciclo di vita.

• Si utilizza la vostra esperienza da progetti e messa in servizio per sviluppare continuamente metodi di distribuzione, standard, liste di controllo e processi e armonizzarli in tutte le posizioni.

• Si utilizzano tecnologie digitali e strumenti AI per migliorare continuamente la risoluzione dei problemi, l'ingegneria, la documentazione e la gestione delle conoscenze.

• Come tecnico:r Esperto:in förderst Potrai scambiare conoscenza all'interno di Manufacturing Engineering e contribuire alla tua esperienza di recensioni, lezioni apprese e l'ulteriore sviluppo dei nostri metodi.

Competenza necessaria

• Hai una laurea tecnica (FH/uni), ad esempio nell'automazione, nell'ingegneria elettrica, nell'ingegneria meccanica, nella meccatronica o nell'ingegneria produttiva. Questo combinato con un'esperienza pratica completa.

• Hai un'esperienza approfondita con impianti di produzione, soprattutto nei settori di messa in servizio, verifica, qualificazione, ramp-up e supporto tecnico del ciclo di vita.

• Sei un vero ingegnere pratico: Ti piace lavorare direttamente su impianti e sistemi, raggiungere il fondo dei problemi tecnici e mettere le soluzioni in pratica te stesso.

• Hai un'alta affinità per gli argomenti dell'IA – idealmente anche esperienze più profonde con loro.

• Hai molto familiarità con l'automazione, il software di impianti, le interfacce e i processi di qualificazione come FAT/SAT e IQ/OQ/PQ.

• Problemi tecnici complessi Sarete analitici e strutturati e convincere attraverso la vostra iniziativa, la forza di attuazione e il senso di responsabilità.

• Ti piace lavorare interdisciplinare, trasmettere le tue conoscenze e può convincere e sostenere gli altri con la tua competenza professionale, anche senza responsabilità di leadership disciplinare.

• Si comunica molto bene in inglese e sono pronti a viaggiare a livello nazionale e internazionale durante importanti fasi di progetto o sfide tecniche.

Persone a Belimo

Gli edifici intelligenti sono creati da persone impegnate. Portiamo insieme persone di talento e creiamo un ambiente in cui possono avere successo. A Belimo, il rispetto, la fiducia e il sostegno reciproco attraverso i confini dipartimentali aiutano a trasformare rapidamente le idee in soluzioni pratiche. Insieme riusciamo a raggiungere più di quanto potessimo raggiungere.

Informazioni su Belimo

Belimo è leader mondiale nello sviluppo, nella produzione e nella vendita di dispositivi di campo per il controllo efficiente dell'impianto di riscaldamento, ventilazione e condizionamento dell'aria. Azionatrici, valvole di controllo, sensori e metri formano il nostro core business. Fondata nel 1975, la società è quotata in Borsa svizzera (SIX) dal 1995.

Compensazioni e vantaggi

A Belimo, crediamo in una compensazione equa, giusta e competitiva. Offriamo uno stipendio che corrisponde alle vostre competenze, esperienza, istruzione e impegno. Oltre alla compensazione, beneficiate di servizi aggiuntivi completi che supportano il vostro benessere mentale, fisico, finanziario e sociale. Belimo è orgogliosa di essere un datore di lavoro che promuove pari opportunità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you not only want to make complex production plants work, but also continuously improve them? With us, you combine technical expertise with modern digital technologies and AI and actively shape the future of our manufacturing engineering.

Main responsibilities

• You take over the technical responsibility for the commissioning, verification and qualification of complex production plants and accompany them until the successful transfer to production.

• You control challenging FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ and PQ activities, working closely with engineering, production, quality, suppliers and our international locations.

• You accompany software deployments, plant upgrades and transfers and ensure that plants and software work reliably in the respective production environment.

• In complex technical challenges, you are the central contact person: you carry out root cause analyses and develop sustainable solutions together with the teams involved.

• You support our production sites with ramp-ups, technical escalations as well as modernizations and lifecycle topics.

• You use your experience from projects and commissioning to continuously develop deployment methods, standards, checklists and processes and harmonize them across locations.

• You use digital technologies and AI tools to continuously improve troubleshooting, engineering, documentation and knowledge management.

• As a technical:r Expert:in förderst You will exchange knowledge within Manufacturing Engineering and contribute your expertise to reviews, lessons learned and the further development of our methods.

Required expertise

• You have a technical degree (FH/uni), e.g. in automation, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, mechatronics or production engineering. This combined with comprehensive relevant practical experience.

• You have in-depth experience with production facilities, especially in the areas of commissioning, verification, qualification, ramp-up and technical lifecycle support.

• You are a real hands-on engineer: You like to work directly on plants and systems, get to the bottom of technical problems and put solutions into practice yourself.

• You have a high affinity for AI topics – ideally also deeper experiences with them.

• You are very familiar with automation, plant software, interfaces and qualification processes such as FAT/SAT and IQ/OQ/PQ.

• Complex technical problems You will be analytical and structured and convince through your own initiative, implementation strength and sense of responsibility.

• You like to work interdisciplinary, pass on your knowledge and can convince and support others with your professional competence, even without disciplinary leadership responsibility.

• You communicate very well in English and are ready to travel nationally and internationally during important project phases or technical challenges.

People at Belimo

Intelligent buildings are created by committed people. We bring talented people together and create an environment where they can succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust and mutual support across departmental boundaries help turn ideas quickly into practical solutions. Together we achieve more than we could ever achieve.

About Belimo

Belimo is the world market leader in the development, manufacture and sale of field devices for energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems. Flap drives, control valves, sensors and meters form our core business. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Stock Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Compensation and Benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, fair and competitive compensation. We offer a salary that matches your skills, experience, education and commitment. In addition to compensation, you benefit from comprehensive additional services that support your mental, physical, financial and social well-being. Belimo is proud to be an employer promoting equal opportunities.

Introduction

Shape the future of innovation by establishing project management excellence across our global R&D organization. As Project Management Officer & Business Analyst, you will drive governance, portfolio insights, and continuous improvement while enabling informed decision-making and successful project execution.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Einleitung

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft der Innovation, indem Sie Projektmanagement-Exzellenz in unserer globalen F & E-Organisation etablieren. Als Project Management Officer & Business Analyst treiben Sie Governance, Portfolio-Einblicke und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voran und ermöglichen gleichzeitig fundierte Entscheidungen und eine erfolgreiche Projektdurchführung.

Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten

• Design, Steuerung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Multiprojektmanagement-Frameworks, Standards und Governance für Group Division Innovation (R&D).

• Definieren, implementieren und betreiben Sie Projektmanagementprozesse, -methoden, -tools, KPIs und Bewertungskriterien als Go-to-Experte für Methodik.

• Führen Sie Portfolio-, Budget- und Performance-Controlling-Analysen durch; synthetisieren Sie Multi-Source-Daten und empfehlen Sie Maßnahmen zur Unterstützung von Managemententscheidungen.

• Die kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Methoden, Standards und Tools, die Identifizierung der Ursachen und die Gewährleistung einer nachhaltigen Akzeptanz in allen Teams. Handeln Sie als Change Agent, indem Sie methodische und prozessbezogene Verbesserungen in überzeugende Narrative für Führungskräfte, Lenkungsgremien und Projektteams übersetzen und so Ausrichtung, Buy-in und nachhaltige Umsetzung sicherstellen.

• Bereitstellung von fachkundiger Beratung, Schulung und Coaching für Peers und Stakeholder, um die korrekte Anwendung der Methoden und die Einhaltung der Standards zu gewährleisten.

• Erleichterung der funktionsübergreifenden Ausrichtung auf Ressourcen, Prioritäten und Arbeitsweisen; Lösung komplexer methodischer und Governance-Fragen.

• Festlegung und Pflege transparenter Dokumentations- und Berichtsstandards für Lenkungsausschüsse und leitende Interessenträger.

Abschluss in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder relevanten Bereich (ETH / Universität / Fachhochschule)

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung bei der Beeinflussung und Ermöglichung funktionsübergreifender Stakeholder in einer Matrixorganisation.

• Analytisches, strukturiertes Denken mit Problemlösermentalität.

Belimo ist Weltmarktführer in der Entwicklung, Produktion und dem Vertrieb von Feldgeräten zur energieeffizienten Steuerung von Heizungs-, Lüftungs- und Klimaanlagen. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Présentation

Façonner l'avenir de l'innovation en établissant l'excellence en gestion de projet dans notre organisation mondiale de R-D. En tant qu'agent de gestion de projet et analyste des affaires, vous dirigerez la gouvernance, les perspectives de portefeuille et l'amélioration continue tout en permettant une prise de décision éclairée et une exécution réussie du projet.

Principales responsabilités

• Concevoir, gouverner et améliorer continuellement les cadres de gestion multiprojets, les normes et la gouvernance pour la Division de groupe Innovation (R-D).

• Définir, mettre en oeuvre et exploiter des processus, des méthodes, des outils, des ICR et des critères d'évaluation en tant qu'experts en méthodologie.

• Effectuer des analyses du portefeuille, du budget et du contrôle du rendement; synthétiser des données multisources et recommander des mesures pour appuyer les décisions de gestion.

• S'approprier l'amélioration continue des méthodes, des normes et des outils, identifier les causes profondes et assurer une adoption durable entre les équipes. Agir en tant qu'agent du changement en traduisant les améliorations méthodologiques et liées aux processus en récits convaincants pour les cadres, les comités directeurs et les équipes de projet, en assurant l'harmonisation, l'adhésion et la mise en oeuvre durable.

• Fournir une orientation, une formation et un encadrement spécialisés aux pairs et aux intervenants afin d'assurer l'application correcte des méthodes et le respect des normes.

• Faciliter l'harmonisation interfonctionnelle des ressources, des priorités et des méthodes de travail; résoudre les questions méthodologiques et de gouvernance complexes.

• Établir et maintenir des normes transparentes en matière de documentation et de rapports pour les comités directeurs et les principaux intervenants.

Expertise requise

•
Diplôme en informatique commerciale, en génie ou dans un domaine pertinent (ETH/ Université/ Université des sciences appliquées)

• Une solide expertise en gestion de projet classique et agile pour la R-D en génie, avec un accent clair sur la méthodologie, la gouvernance et l'excellence des processus.

• Expérience éprouvée qui influence et permet aux intervenants interfonctionnels d'une organisation matricielle.

• Une pensée analytique et structurée avec une mentalité de résolution de problèmes.

• Des entreprises solides ont la capacité de traduire les données et les idées en recommandations pragmatiques. Forte intuition des intervenants et compétences interpersonnelles; capable de lire rapidement les situations et le public, d'adapter les styles de communication et de renforcer la confiance à tous les niveaux – des comités exécutifs aux équipes de projet.

• L'anglais des affaires (écrit et parlé); le travail confiant dans un environnement international et multiculturel.

• Certification de gestion de projet (PfMP, IPMA B) préférée.

• Personnalité proactive et axée sur le service, hautement responsable et résistante.

Les gens de Belimo

Les bâtiments intelligents commencent par des gens dévoués. Nous réunissons des gens talentueux et favorisons un environnement propice à la réussite. Chez Belimo, le respect, la confiance et le soutien à travers les ministères aident les idées à avancer rapidement vers des solutions réelles, parce que nous obtenons plus ensemble que nous ne le pouvions jamais seuls.

À propos de Belimo

Belimo est le leader mondial dans le développement, la production et la vente de dispositifs de terrain pour le contrôle énergétique des systèmes de chauffage, de ventilation et de climatisation. Nos activités principales sont les actionneurs d'amortisseurs, les vannes de commande, les capteurs et les compteurs. Fondée en 1975, la société est cotée à la Bourse suisse (SIX) depuis 1995.

Rémunération et avantages sociaux

Chez Belimo, nous croyons en une rémunération juste, équitable et concurrentielle. Nous offrons une rémunération qui reflète vos compétences, votre expérience, votre éducation et votre emplacement. Au-delà de la rémunération, vous bénéficierez d'un ensemble complet de récompenses conçu pour soutenir votre santé, votre bien-être financier et votre succès à long terme. Belimo est fier d'être un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction

Do you like to work with your hands, have your fingertips and attach importance to exact work? Then you are exactly right with us.

In this role, you mount high-quality Belimo field devices on the production line. With your precise way of working, you help ensure that our products meet the highest quality standards worldwide.

We are looking for employees for our early, late or night shift. The setting is in each case fixed for one layer. Apply yourself to the layer that best suits your everyday life.

Main responsibilities

• Assembly of finished products and assemblies according to production order

• Testing of assembled products according to specified quality standards

• Careful work with individual parts and components

• Transportable packaging of the finished products

• Compliance with assembly, quality and process specifications

Required expertise

• Good fine motor skills and enjoyment of precise manual work

• Careful, reliable and quality-conscious work method

• Physical fitness and willingness to stand predominantly during work

• Good knowledge of German to understand work instructions

• Experience in production or assembly is advantageous

• Motivated lateral entrants are also welcome

People at Belimo

Intelligent buildings are created by committed people. We bring talented people together and create an environment where they can succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust and mutual support across departmental boundaries help turn ideas quickly into practical solutions. Together we achieve more than we could ever achieve alone.

About Belimo

Belimo is the world market leader in the development, manufacture and sale of field devices for energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems. Flap drives, control valves, sensors and meters form our core business. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Stock Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Remuneration and additional benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, fair and competitive compensation. We offer a salary that matches your skills, experience, education and location. In addition to the compensation, you benefit from comprehensive additional services that support your mental, physical, financial and social well-being. Belimo is proud to be an employer promoting equal opportunities.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction

Do you like to work with your hands, have your fingertips and attach importance to exact work? Then you are exactly right with us.

In this role, you mount high-quality Belimo field devices on the production line. With your precise way of working, you help ensure that our products meet the highest quality standards worldwide.

We are looking for employees for our early, late or night shift. The setting is in each case fixed for one layer. Apply yourself to the layer that best suits your everyday life.

Main responsibilities

• Assembly of finished products and assemblies according to production order

• Testing of assembled products according to specified quality standards

• Careful work with individual parts and components

• Transportable packaging of the finished products

• Compliance with assembly, quality and process specifications

Required expertise

• Good fine motor skills and enjoyment of precise manual work

• Careful, reliable and quality-conscious work method

• Physical fitness and willingness to stand predominantly during work

• Good knowledge of German to understand work instructions

• Experience in production or assembly is advantageous

• Motivated lateral entrants are also welcome

People at Belimo

Intelligent buildings are created by committed people. We bring talented people together and create an environment where they can succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust and mutual support across departmental boundaries help turn ideas quickly into practical solutions. Together we achieve more than we could ever achieve alone.

About Belimo

Belimo is the world market leader in the development, manufacture and sale of field devices for energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems. Flap drives, control valves, sensors and meters form our core business. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Stock Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Remuneration and additional benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, fair and competitive compensation. We offer a salary that matches your skills, experience, education and location. In addition to the compensation, you benefit from comprehensive additional services that support your mental, physical, financial and social well-being. Belimo is proud to be an employer promoting equal opportunities.

Gemeinsam mit einem hochmotivierten Team entwickelst du Mixed-Signal-ASICs, die das Herzstück jedes Belimo-Antriebs und -Sensors bilden und millionenfach produziert werden. Dabei übernimmst du die technische Verantwortung für den Analogteil, der von unserem ASIC-Lieferanten extern entwickelt wird.

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten

• Spezifikation und Verifikation des Analogteils unserer ASICs

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem ASIC-Lieferanten sowie gemeinsames Lösen technischer Herausforderungen bei der Entwicklung des Analogteils

• Technische Schnittstelle zum internen Team für den Digitalteil sowie zum Systemverifikationsteam, das die ASICs innerhalb von Belimo-Geräten prüft

• Entwicklung und Pflege von Leiterplatten für die Entwicklung und Qualifizierung der ASICs

• Analoges Schaltungsdesign neuer Funktionen

 Masterabschluss in Elektrotechnik, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Mikroelektronik oder Analogelektronik

•
 Mehrjährige Erfahrung im analogen Schaltungsdesign sowie in der Messtechnik, einschliesslich Requirements Engineering und Verifikationsmethoden

•
 Erfahrung im Bereich Mikroelektronik ist ein grosser Pluspunkt

•
 Interesse an digitalem Schaltungsdesign (Verilog oder VHDL)

 Begeisterung für neue Technologien und innovative Ideen, hohe Eigeninitiative, ausgeprägtes Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise

Introduzione

Vuoi plasmare attivamente i processi dei dati master globali e contribuire efficacemente alla tua esperienza SAP e MDM? In questo ruolo, vi assumete la responsabilità del nostro Master Data Governance e sviluppate soluzioni sostenibili con diverse aree specializzate

Principali responsabilità

• L'utente progetta e si assume la responsabilità della gestione globale dei dati master del Gruppo BELIMO in conformità con la strategia della supply chain

• Potrai supervisionare e sviluppare gli strumenti MDM utilizzati a livello globale e i processi SAP e utilizzare le tue competenze in SAP Customizing.

• Garantisci standard globali e una qualità dei dati padroneggiata in modo sostenibile, tenendo d'occhio le relazioni e gli effetti lungo i processi.

• Coordinate e siete responsabili delle operazioni di calcolo periodico e del calcolo del bilancio annuale

• In qualità di referente competente, consiglia e accompagna diverse aree specializzate, media tra diverse esigenze e sviluppa insieme soluzioni realizzabili

• Con una forte gestione e persuasione degli stakeholder, otterrete comprensione per le strutture di dati sostenibili e vincono diversi gruppi di stakeholder per soluzioni congiunte.

• Conduci progetti MDM cross-divisional, pensa in modo rete e assicurati che le soluzioni sostenibili siano ancorate con successo nell'organizzazione

Competenza necessaria

• Hai una laurea, preferibilmente con un focus sui dati, analisi, amministrazione aziendale o una disciplina paragonabile.

• Porterai almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante nella pianificazione della produzione e nella gestione dei dati master e conoscere i requisiti di un ambiente di produzione complesso.

• Hai competenze SAP approfondite tra cui la personalizzazione e la buona conoscenza dei moduli MM, PP, SD e BI e la configurazione variante.

• Avete esperienza nella gestione del progetto e portare know-how nell'analisi dei dati e grandi dati.

• Con il vostro pensiero logico, analitico e in rete, si cattura rapidamente relazioni complesse, mantenere una panoramica e lavorare con precisione e orientata alla soluzione.

• Sei una personalità forte e convincente che consiglia con competenza diverse parti interessate, riunisce interessi diversi e porta anche la persistenza in situazioni difficili.

• Un modo efficiente e decisionale di lavorare, l'orientamento del team e le ottime competenze tedesche e inglesi si completano il tuo profilo.

Persone a Belimo

Gli edifici intelligenti sono creati da persone impegnate. Portiamo insieme persone di talento e creiamo un ambiente in cui possono avere successo. A Belimo, il rispetto, la fiducia e il sostegno reciproco attraverso i confini dipartimentali aiutano a trasformare rapidamente le idee in soluzioni pratiche. Insieme riusciamo a raggiungere più di quanto potremmo mai raggiungere da soli.

Informazioni su Belimo

Belimo è leader mondiale nello sviluppo, nella produzione e nella vendita di dispositivi di campo per il controllo efficiente dell'impianto di riscaldamento, ventilazione e condizionamento dell'aria. Azionatrici, valvole di controllo, sensori e metri formano il nostro core business. Fondata nel 1975, la società è quotata sulla Borsa Svizzera (SIX) dal 1995.

Remunerazione e benefici aggiuntivi

A Belimo, crediamo in una compensazione equa, giusta e competitiva. Offriamo uno stipendio che corrisponde alle tue competenze, esperienza, istruzione e posizione. Oltre alla compensazione, si beneficia di servizi aggiuntivi completi che supportano il vostro benessere mentale, fisico, finanziario e sociale. Belimo è orgogliosa di essere un datore di lavoro che promuove pari opportunità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction

Do you want to actively shape global master data processes and contribute your SAP and MDM expertise effectively? In this role, you take responsibility for our Master Data Governance and develop sustainable solutions with various specialist areas

Main responsibilities

• You design and take responsibility for the global master data governance of the BELIMO Group in accordance with the supply chain strategy

• You will supervise and develop the globally used MDM tools and SAP processes and use your expertise in SAP Customizing.

• You ensure global standards and sustainably high master data quality while keeping an eye on relationships and effects along processes.

• You coordinate and are responsible for periodic calculation runs as well as the calculation for the annual financial statements

• As a competent contact person, you advise and accompany different specialist areas, mediate between different requirements and jointly develop viable solutions

• With strong stakeholder management and persuasiveness, you will gain understanding for sustainable data structures and win different stakeholder groups for joint solutions.

• You lead cross-divisional MDM projects, think in a networked way and ensure that sustainable solutions are successfully anchored in the organization

Required expertise

• You have a bachelor’s degree, preferably with a focus on data, analytics, business administration or a comparable discipline.

• You will bring at least 5 years of relevant professional experience in production planning and master data management and know the requirements of a complex production environment.

• You have in-depth SAP expertise including customizing as well as very good knowledge of the modules MM, PP, SD and BI and the variant configuration.

• You have experience in project management and bring know-how in data analysis and big data.

• With your logical, analytical and networked thinking, you quickly capture complex relationships, keep an overview and work precisely and solution-oriented.

• You are a strong and convincing personality who competently advises different stakeholders, brings different interests together and also brings persistence in demanding situations.

• An efficient and decision-making way of working, team orientation and very good German and English skills round off your profile.

People at Belimo

Intelligent buildings are created by committed people. We bring talented people together and create an environment where they can succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust and mutual support across departmental boundaries help turn ideas into practical solutions quickly. Together we achieve more than we could ever achieve alone.

About Belimo

Belimo is the world market leader in the development, manufacture and sale of field devices for energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems. Flap drives, control valves, sensors and meters form our core business. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Stock Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Remuneration and additional benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, fair and competitive compensation. We offer a salary that matches your skills, experience, education and location. In addition to the compensation, you benefit from comprehensive additional services that support your mental, physical, financial and social well-being. Belimo is proud to be an employer who promotes equal opportunities.

jobs.description:
Einführung

Fachkompetenz im Export trifft auf Leadership: In dieser Schlüsselrolle führst du ein engagiertes Team, stellst eine professionelle internationale Exportabwicklung sicher und treibst Prozesse und Systeme weiter voran.

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten

• Du führst dein Team, motivierst und entwickelst deine Mitarbeitenden und stellst gemeinsam mit ihnen eine zuverlässige und qualitativ hochwertige Exportabwicklung sicher.

• Du verantwortest die weltweite Abwicklung von Waren- und Dokumentensendungen inklusive aller erforderlichen Export- und Zolldokumente, Ursprungszeugnisse, Beglaubigungen, Carnet ATA/Freipassendungen sowie der elektronischen und manuellen Übermittlung an Spediteure, Zollämter und Kunden.

• Du erstellst und prüfst Abnahmeprüfzeugnisse und Materialzertifikate, pflegst die dafür notwendigen Stammdaten und unterstützt bei Importvorgängen, insbesondere bei Rücklieferungen und Reparatursendungen.

• Als kompetente Ansprechperson bearbeitest du Fragestellungen rund um Zoll, Exportkontrolle und Aussenhandel und schulst unsere Gruppengesellschaften in Exportprozessen sowie in SAP GTS und SAP EWM.

• Du entwickelst unsere Exportprozesse, Systemlösungen, Arbeitsanweisungen und Schulungsunterlagen laufend weiter und sorgst für eine strukturierte Dokumentation und Archivierung gemäss ISO 9001:2000 und ISO 14001:2000.

• Du behältst Qualität, Termine und Kosten im Blick, leitest bei Abweichungen geeignete Massnahmen ein und stellst die Einhaltung von Arbeitszeit-, Ferien-, Abwesenheits- und Arbeitssicherheitsvorgaben sicher. Auch die Feiertagsplanung sowie die Pflege der Spediteure im ERP-System gehören dazu.

• In deiner Führungsrolle übernimmst du gemeinsam mit deiner Führungskraft und HR die relevanten Personalprozesse und -entscheidungen, von Zielvereinbarungen und Mitarbeitendenbeurteilungen bis zu Bonus- und Lohngesprächen, und sorgst durch Gefährdungsbeurteilungen und entsprechende Massnahmen für ein sicheres Arbeitsumfeld.

Erforderliche Fachkenntnisse

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction

Export expertise meets leadership: In this key role, you lead a dedicated team, ensure professional international export processing and drive processes and systems forward.

Main responsibilities

• You lead your team, motivate and develop your employees and together with them ensure a reliable and high-quality export process.

• You are responsible for the worldwide handling of shipments of goods and documents including all necessary export and customs documents, certificates of origin, certifications, ATA carnet/free passes as well as electronic and manual transmission to forwarders, customs offices and customers.

• You create and check acceptance certificates and material certificates, maintain the necessary master data and support during import processes, in particular in return deliveries and repair shipments.

• As a competent contact person, you will deal with issues relating to customs, export control and foreign trade and train our Group companies in export processes as well as in SAP GTS and SAP EWM.

• You will continue to develop our export processes, system solutions, work instructions and training documents and ensure structured documentation and archiving in accordance with ISO 9001:2000 and ISO 14001:2000.

• You keep an eye on quality, deadlines and costs, initiate appropriate measures in the event of deviations and ensure compliance with working time, holiday, absence and work safety requirements. This also includes holiday planning and the maintenance of freight forwarders in the ERP system.

• In your leadership role, together with your manager and HR, you take on the relevant personnel processes and decisions, from target agreements and employee assessments to bonus and wage discussions, and ensure a safe working environment through risk assessments and corresponding measures.

Required expertise

• You have a basic commercial training and a higher specialist training in export and/or foreign trade, ideally as a foreign trade specialist with a federal professional certificate or foreign trade manager.

• You will have at least five years of professional experience in the international industrial, commercial or logistics environment and know the operational export processing and its requirements from practice.

• You have already gained at least two years of leadership experience, lead with clarity and appreciation and understand how to motivate and develop employees.

• You are SAP-savvy and have very good IT knowledge, especially in SAP SD, MM, PP, EWM and BI as well as MS Office.

• You bring logistics and project experience, think across divisional boundaries and develop solutions with a medium- and long-term view.

• You convince with entrepreneurial thinking, initiative and communication strength, work accurately and reliably even under deadline pressure and win over different stakeholder groups for joint solutions.

• You communicate in German and English, enjoy working as a team and are committed, committed and convincing.

People at Belimo

Intelligent buildings are created by committed people. We bring talented people together and create an environment where they can succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust and mutual support across departmental boundaries help turn ideas quickly into practical solutions. Together we achieve more than we could ever achieve alone.

About Belimo

Belimo is the world market leader in the development, manufacture and sale of field devices for energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems. Flap drives, control valves, sensors and meters form our core business. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Stock Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Remuneration and additional benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, fair and competitive compensation. We offer a salary that matches your skills, experience, education and location. In addition to the compensation, you benefit from comprehensive additional services that support your mental, physical, financial and social well-being. Belimo is proud to be an employer promoting equal opportunities.

Lead the order processing team in terms of personnel and expertise, motivate and further develop it in a targeted manner

Guidate e allenate i vostri team attraverso una forte fase di crescita, ottimizzate i processi e tenete in funzione il nostro mondo della logistica – dal ricevimento delle merci ai robot high-bay. Se ti senti come assumere la leadership, padroneggiare i processi e guidare l'innovazione, sei al posto giusto con noi.

Principali responsabilità

• Guidare, motivare, sviluppare: rafforzare e sviluppare i vostri leader e dipendenti del team (totale circa 80 dipendenti), promuovere competenze di leadership e accompagnare l'organizzazione attraverso una fase di crescita dinamica.

• Personale di masterizzazione e pianificazione delle assegnazioni: Pianificazione ottimale dei turni (3 turni), gestione delle emergenze e gestione delle risorse sono nelle vostre mani.

• Prestazioni, qualità e costi sotto controllo: Lei è responsabile per la ricevuta di merci, lo stoccaggio, la raccolta, lo smaltimento e la spedizione – compresi i bilanci, l'inventario e la gestione dell'inventario.

• Tecnologia e funzionamento degli impianti: Garantisci la disponibilità di tutti gli impianti (inclusi i magazzini di alta sicurezza e piccole parti altamente automatizzati e il magazzino esterno).

• Ottimizzazione dei processi logistici: Qualità ed efficienza – Sviluppi ulteriormente i processi, proteggi i beni di capitale e garantisci la loro manutenzione sostenibile e il miglioramento continuo nel senso del CIP.

• HSSE & compliance living: sicurezza del lavoro, salute, ambiente, requisiti legali, norme ISO e linee guida interne – Tieni tutto e lo sviluppi ulteriormente.

• Reporting & Control: Le relazioni statistiche, KPI e BSC costituiscono la base per il monitoraggio continuo e il miglioramento delle prestazioni logistiche.

• Qualità & Progetti: Supporto per casi di qualità, comunicazioni di processo e partecipazione attiva a progetti rilevanti.

Competenza necessaria

descriptionByLocale.en:

You lead and coach your teams through a strong growth phase, optimize processes and keep our logistics world running – from goods receipt to high-bay robots. If you feel like taking on leadership, mastering processes and driving innovation, you are at the right place with us.

Main responsibilities

• Mastering personnel and assignment planning: Optimal shift planning (3-shift operation), emergency management and resource management are in your hands.

• Performance, quality and costs under control: You are responsible for goods receipt, storage, picking, disposal and shipping – including budgets, inventory and inventory management.

• Technology & plant operation: You ensure the availability of all plants (including highly automated high-bay and small parts warehouse and external external warehouse).

• Optimizing logistics processes: Quality and efficiency – You develop processes further, procure capital goods and ensure their sustainable maintenance and continuous improvement in the sense of the CIP.

• HSSE & compliance living: occupational safety, health, environment, legal requirements, ISO standards and internal guidelines – You keep everything and develop it further.

• Reporting & Control: Statistics, KPI and BSC reports serve as the basis for continuously monitoring and improving logistics performance.

• Quality & Projects: Support for quality cases, process communications and active participation in relevant projects.

Required expertise

• Completed technical or logistical vocational training (e.g. logistician/EFZ) plus higher specialist training in logistics

• Many years of management experience with responsibility for large teams (at least 80 people) as well as the ability to accompany and develop teams and managers in a dynamic growth field

• Mind. 10 years of professional experience in international industrial, commercial or logistics companies in the field of operations with focus on logistics

• In-depth experience in the successful implementation of operational excellence initiatives, process optimization, change management and cross-divisional transformation projects

• Very good IT and SAP skills (SD, MM, PP, EWM) and secure communication in German (minimum C1) and English (minimum B2)

• Entrepreneurial thinking, decision-making pleasure and high independence

• Team player with assertiveness: strong communication skills, conflict competence, reliability and structured working methods

People at Belimo

Intelligent buildings are created by committed people. We bring talented people together and create an environment where they can succeed. Belimo est fier d'être un employeur qui favorise l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Head of Group Treasury 100%
jobs.description:
Introduction

As Head of Group Treasury , you will shape and further develop Belimo’s global Treasury function at an important stage of its growth. You will take ownership of liquidity planning, cash management, financing, banking relationships, and financial risk management across the Group. This is a hands-on leadership role for a treasury professional who combines strong technical expertise with the ability to understand complex cash flows, build trusted internal relationships, and establish structures that create resilience for Belimo worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and continuously develop the Group Treasury function in alignment with BELIMO’s values and leadership principles.

• Establish reliable global liquidity planning and create transparency across the Group’s cash flows.

• Further develop cash management, cash pooling, and intercompany financing structures across key markets and currencies.

• Define and implement treasury policies, governance frameworks, standards, and internal controls.

• Lead financing activities and manage relationships with banks, investors, rating agencies, and other financing partners.

• Define and oversee hedging strategies for foreign exchange, interest rate, and other treasury-related risks.

• Drive treasury digitalization, automation, process improvements, and high-quality treasury reporting.

• Advise Executive Management and Group Finance on strategic initiatives, including M&A, investments, and financing projects.

Required Expertise

• You hold a university degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline. A professional treasury qualification and/or MBA is an advantage.

• You bring substantial, relevant experience in corporate treasury, ideally gained in a multinational organization with complex international cash flows and group structures.

• You have practical expertise in liquidity planning, cash management, cash pooling, intercompany financing, and financial risk management.

• You have experience managing complex stakeholder relationships across an international organization, including finance teams, business leaders, subsidiaries, external partners, and financial institutions.

• You are familiar with Treasury Management Systems, banking platforms, treasury digitalization, and the treasury-related implications of IFRS.

• You communicate confidently in English, both verbally and in writing. German is a strong plus and will help you build meaningful connections across Belimo.

• You are reliable, accountable, and pragmatic, with strong analytical skills and the confidence to make well-founded decisions.

• You are a credible and collaborative leader who builds trust, communicates complex topics clearly, and enjoys developing both people and structures.

People at Belimo

Smart buildings start with dedicated people. We bring talented people together and foster an environment to succeed. At Belimo, respect, trust, and support across departments help ideas move quickly into real-world solutions, because we achieve more together than we ever could alone.

About Belimo

Belimo is the global market leader in the development, production, and sales of field devices for the energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation and air-conditioning systems. The focus of our core business is on damper actuators, control valves, sensors and meters. Founded in 1975, the company has been listed on the Swiss Exchange (SIX) since 1995.

Compensation & Benefits

At Belimo, we believe in fair, equitable, and competitive compensation. We offer pay that reflects your skills, experience, education, and location. Beyond compensation, you'll benefit from a comprehensive rewards package designed to support your health, financial wellbeing, and long-term success. Belimo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Ready for your next step? We look forward to hearing from you.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione

Come Capo del Tesoro del Gruppo, si forma e svilupperà ulteriormente la funzione del Tesoro globale di Belimo in una fase importante della sua crescita. Prenderai la proprietà della pianificazione della liquidità, della gestione dei contanti, del finanziamento, delle relazioni bancarie e della gestione dei rischi finanziari in tutto il Gruppo. Questo è un ruolo di leadership pratico per un professionista del tesoro che combina una forte competenza tecnica con la capacità di comprendere flussi di cassa complessi, costruire relazioni interne affidabili e stabilire strutture che creano resilienza per Belimo in tutto il mondo.

Principali responsabilità

• Guidare e sviluppare continuamente la funzione del Tesoro del Gruppo in allineamento con i valori e i principi di leadership di BELIMO.

• Stabilire una pianificazione di liquidità globale affidabile e creare trasparenza sui flussi di cassa del Gruppo.

• Sviluppare ulteriormente cash management, cash pooling e strutture di finanziamento intercompany su mercati chiave e valute.

• Definire e implementare politiche di tesoreria, quadri di governance, standard e controlli interni.

• Leader attività di finanziamento e gestire le relazioni con banche, investitori, agenzie di rating e altri partner di finanziamento.

• Definire e supervisionare le strategie di copertura per cambio, tasso di interesse e altri rischi legati al tesoro.

• Digitalizzazione del tesoro di trasmissione, automazione, miglioramenti del processo e report del tesoro di alta qualità.

• Consigliamo Executive Management e Group Finance a iniziative strategiche, tra cui M&A, investimenti e progetti di finanziamento.

Competenza richiesta

• Hai una laurea in Finanza, Economia, Business Administration, o una disciplina relativa. Una qualifica professionale di tesoreria e/o MBA è un vantaggio.

• Porti esperienza sostanziale e rilevante nel tesoro aziendale, idealmente acquisita in un'organizzazione multinazionale con flussi di cassa internazionali complessi e strutture di gruppo.

• Hai competenze pratiche nella pianificazione della liquidità, gestione dei contanti, cash pooling, finanziamento intercompany e gestione dei rischi finanziari.

• Hai esperienza nella gestione di complesse relazioni con gli stakeholder in un'organizzazione internazionale, tra cui team finanziari, leader aziendali, filiali, partner esterni e istituzioni finanziarie.

• Conoscete i Sistemi di Gestione del Tesoro, le piattaforme bancarie, la digitalizzazione del tesoro e le implicazioni relative al tesoro di IFRS.

• Si comunica con fiducia in inglese, sia verbalmente che per iscritto. Il tedesco è un vantaggio forte e vi aiuterà a costruire connessioni significative attraverso Belimo.

• Sei affidabile, responsabile e pragmatico, con forti capacità analitiche e la fiducia di prendere decisioni ben fondate.

• Sei un leader credibile e collaborativo che costruisce fiducia, comunica con chiarezza argomenti complessi, e gode di sviluppare sia persone che strutture.

Persone a Belimo

Gli edifici intelligenti iniziano con persone dedicate. Portiamo insieme persone di talento e adottiamo un ambiente per avere successo. A Belimo, il rispetto, la fiducia e il supporto nei dipartimenti aiutano le idee a muoversi rapidamente in soluzioni del mondo reale, perché raggiungiamo più insieme di quanto mai potremmo soli.

About Belimo

Belimo è leader del mercato globale nello sviluppo, produzione e vendita di dispositivi di campo per il controllo efficiente dell'energia dei sistemi di riscaldamento, ventilazione e climatizzazione. Il focus del nostro core business è sugli attuatori ammortizzatori, valvole di controllo, sensori e metri. Fondata nel 1975, la società è quotata sulla Borsa Svizzera (SIX) dal 1995.

Compensazioni e vantaggi

A Belimo, crediamo in una compensazione equa, equa e competitiva. Offriamo la paga che riflette le vostre abilità, esperienza, istruzione e la posizione. Oltre alla compensazione, potrete beneficiare di un pacchetto completo di ricompense progettato per sostenere la vostra salute, benessere finanziario e successo a lungo termine. Belimo è orgogliosa di essere un Equal Opportunity Employer.

Pronti per il prossimo passo? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti.
